meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按文字描述生成或修改图片，调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型（如 Gemini、FLUX），产出照片、插画、概念图等非技术类图像，并保存为 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑照片、插画、概念图等非技术类图片时触发；技术图表会改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 画一张夕阳下的山景，保存为 PNG。
say.note: 会调用脚本生成图片并保存。

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成紫色。
say.note: 会读取输入图片并编辑。

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 生成一张太空猫插画。
say.note: 会以指定模型生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images from text descriptions using OpenRouter image models (e.g., Gemini, FLUX), producing photos, illustrations, concept art and other non-technical images saved as PNG files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate or edit non-technical images such as photos, illustrations, concept art, etc.; technical diagrams are handled by the scientific-schematics skill.

say_en.text: Draw a sunset over mountains and save it as PNG.
say_en.note: Calls the script and saves the image.

say_en.text: Make the sky purple in this photo.
say_en.note: Reads the input image and edits it.

say_en.text: Generate a space cat illustration using flux.2-pro.
